openaiSpec.name: gemini_nano_banana_pro

prompt.description: The description of the image to generate or edit.

images.description: Pass image attachment ids from <CHAT_ATTACHMENTS> to edit or use as references (up to 14). Pass an empty array [] to generate a new image without using previous images. Omit this parameter to edit images from this plugin's last output.

filename.description: A short, descriptive file name for the created image, without extension.

openaiSpec.description: Generate a new image, or edit existing image attachments with Gemini Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image), for complex instructions and high-fidelity text.

userSettings.name: geminikey
userSettings.label: Gemini API Key (Required)
userSettings.description: Get an API key from Google AI Studio.
